### AttributeType {#type-commerz-catalog-attributes-contracts-attributetype}

`Commerz\Catalog\Attributes\Contracts\AttributeType`

A data type of attribute values, contributed under kind `attribute_type`; stateless, pure, no IO.

```php
interface AttributeType {
    const KIND = 'attribute_type';
    // Validates and canonicalizes a definition config (sorted keys, defaults filled).
    config(array $config): array;
    // Version of the config format this type writes; stored as attributes.config_version.
    configVersion(): int;
    // Facts of a canonical value for the filter projection.
    index(array|string|int|bool $value, \Commerz\Catalog\Attributes\Data\AttributeDefinition $definition): array;
    // Key stored with every definition: 'decimal', 'acme.color_swatch'.
    key(): string;
    // Input (from a command, an import or its own stored form) to the canonical stored value. Idempotent: normalize(normalize(x)) === normalize(x). Never returns null or a float.
    normalize(mixed $input, \Commerz\Catalog\Attributes\Data\AttributeDefinition $definition): array|string|int|bool;
    operators(): array;
    // Whether definitions of this type own a list of choices.
    usesChoices(): bool;
}
```

### Collections {#type-commerz-catalog-collections-contracts-collections}

`Commerz\Catalog\Collections\Contracts\Collections`

Curated manual collections with explicit product positioning and dynamic smart collections backed by serialized {@see AttributeFilter} and {@see VariantFilter} rules.

```php
interface Collections {
    archive(\Commerz\Catalog\Collections\Data\ArchiveCollection $command): \Commerz\Catalog\Collections\Data\CollectionView;
    create(\Commerz\Catalog\Collections\Data\CreateCollection $command): \Commerz\Catalog\Collections\Data\CollectionView;
    find(\Commerz\Catalog\Collections\Data\CollectionId $id): \Commerz\Catalog\Collections\Data\CollectionView;
    findByCode(string $code): \Commerz\Catalog\Collections\Data\CollectionView;
    list(\Commerz\Catalog\Collections\Data\ListCollections $query): \Commerz\Pagination\Page;
    // Active manual collections explicitly containing the given product, ordered by `code`.
    ofProduct(\Commerz\Catalog\Products\Data\ProductId $product): array;
    // Resolves paginated products of a manual (by `position`, then `handle`) or smart (by `handle`) collection.
    products(\Commerz\Catalog\Collections\Data\ListCollectionProducts $query): \Commerz\Pagination\Page;
    // Inserts or repositions specific products in a manual collection and returns all members ordered by `(position, handle)`.
    putProducts(\Commerz\Catalog\Collections\Data\PutCollectionProducts $command): array;
    // Removes specific products from a manual collection.
    removeProducts(\Commerz\Catalog\Collections\Data\RemoveCollectionProducts $command): void;
    // Replaces all members of a manual collection and returns them ordered by `(position, handle)`.
    setProducts(\Commerz\Catalog\Collections\Data\SetCollectionProducts $command): array;
    update(\Commerz\Catalog\Collections\Data\UpdateCollection $command): \Commerz\Catalog\Collections\Data\CollectionView;
}
```

```php
    // Serializes the filter list into a canonical JSON-encodable rule array.

}
```

### Listings {#type-commerz-catalog-listings-contracts-listings}

`Commerz\Catalog\Listings\Contracts\Listings`

Listings: in which channels a product is offered and when. The channel is checked through the core `Channels` contract at publication; archiving a channel later leaves its listings in place (the core refuses sales there).

```php
interface Listings {
    find(\Commerz\Catalog\Products\Data\ProductId $product, \Commerz\Stores\Data\ChannelId $channel): \Commerz\Catalog\Listings\Data\ListingView;
    ofProduct(\Commerz\Catalog\Products\Data\ProductId $product): array;
    publish(\Commerz\Catalog\Listings\Data\PublishProduct $command): \Commerz\Catalog\Listings\Data\ListingView;
    unpublish(\Commerz\Catalog\Listings\Data\UnpublishProduct $command): \Commerz\Catalog\Listings\Data\ListingView;
}
```

### Products {#type-commerz-catalog-products-contracts-products}

`Commerz\Catalog\Products\Contracts\Products`

Products: what is sold, described by attributes of its type. Every change is one transaction; a failed attribute value leaves the product, its document and its filter projection unchanged.

```php
interface Products {
    archive(\Commerz\Catalog\Products\Data\ArchiveProduct $command): \Commerz\Catalog\Products\Data\ProductView;
    create(\Commerz\Catalog\Products\Data\CreateProduct $command): \Commerz\Catalog\Products\Data\ProductView;
    find(\Commerz\Catalog\Products\Data\ProductId $id): \Commerz\Catalog\Products\Data\ProductView;
    findByHandle(string $handle): \Commerz\Catalog\Products\Data\ProductView;
    list(\Commerz\Catalog\Products\Data\ListProducts $query): \Commerz\Pagination\Page;
    setAttributes(\Commerz\Catalog\Products\Data\SetProductAttributes $command): \Commerz\Catalog\Products\Data\ProductView;
    update(\Commerz\Catalog\Products\Data\UpdateProduct $command): \Commerz\Catalog\Products\Data\ProductView;
    // Batch upserts products by `handle` in one atomic transaction with bounded SQL queries, grouped `cmz_attribute_index` reindexing, and compressed Outbox events.
    upsertMany(\Commerz\Catalog\Products\Data\UpsertProducts $command): \Commerz\Catalog\Products\Data\UpsertProductsResult;
}
```

### AttributeFilter {#type-commerz-catalog-products-data-attributefilter}

`Commerz\Catalog\Products\Data\AttributeFilter`

A condition on a filterable attribute. Values are inputs of the attribute's type: they are normalized like a written value, so '1.5' finds a stored '1.50'. Every filter of a query holds on one and the same active variant (CAT-03).

```php
final readonly class AttributeFilter {
    const MAX_VALUES = 100;
    public readonly string $attribute;
    public readonly \Commerz\Catalog\Attributes\Enums\FilterOperator $operator;
    public readonly array $values;
    // min <= value <= max; a null bound leaves that side open.
    static between(string $attribute, mixed $min = null, mixed $max = null): self;
    // The value equals; for a multi-choice attribute: the value list contains this choice.
    static equals(string $attribute, mixed $value): self;
    // The value is one of these; for a multi-choice attribute: any of these choices is in the value list.
    static in(string $attribute, array $values): self;
}
```

### StorefrontProjection {#type-commerz-catalog-projection-contracts-storefrontprojection}

`Commerz\Catalog\Projection\Contracts\StorefrontProjection`

Denormalized single-row storefront read model over `cmz_storefront_products`, kept up to date via Outbox events (`catalog.*`, `pricing.*`, `inventory.*`) or explicit rebuild commands.

```php
interface StorefrontProjection {
    // Single-row read by `(channel_id, locale, product_id)`, or null when not projected.
    find(\Commerz\Stores\Data\ChannelId $channel, string $locale, \Commerz\Catalog\Products\Data\ProductId $product): ?\Commerz\Catalog\Projection\Data\StorefrontProductView;
    // Single-table storefront read by `(channel_id, locale, handle)`.
    findByHandle(\Commerz\Stores\Data\ChannelId $channel, string $locale, string $handle): ?\Commerz\Catalog\Projection\Data\StorefrontProductView;
    // Single-row read by `(channel_id, locale, product_id)`.
    get(\Commerz\Stores\Data\ChannelId $channel, string $locale, \Commerz\Catalog\Products\Data\ProductId $product): \Commerz\Catalog\Projection\Data\StorefrontProductView;
    list(\Commerz\Catalog\Projection\Data\ListStorefrontProducts $query): \Commerz\Pagination\Page;
    // Rebuilds all storefront rows for an entire channel across all of its configured locales. Returns the number of projected rows written.
    projectChannel(\Commerz\Stores\Data\ChannelId $channel): int;
    // Materializes (or deletes if unpublished/archived) storefront rows for one product across its listed channels (or a single `$channel` when specified). Returns the number of projected rows written.
    projectProduct(\Commerz\Catalog\Products\Data\ProductId $product, ?\Commerz\Stores\Data\ChannelId $channel = null): int;
}
```

### Variants {#type-commerz-catalog-variants-contracts-variants}

`Commerz\Catalog\Variants\Contracts\Variants`

Variants: what is sold. Every sellable is a variant; a combination of axis values is unique within its product (CAT-01), whatever the number of concurrent requests. Each change is one transaction.

```php
interface Variants {
    archive(\Commerz\Catalog\Variants\Data\ArchiveVariant $command): \Commerz\Catalog\Variants\Data\VariantView;
    create(\Commerz\Catalog\Variants\Data\CreateVariant $command): \Commerz\Catalog\Variants\Data\VariantView;
    find(\Commerz\Catalog\Variants\Data\VariantId $id): \Commerz\Catalog\Variants\Data\VariantView;
    findBySku(string $sku): \Commerz\Catalog\Variants\Data\VariantView;
    // All or nothing: either every planned combination the product lacks is created, or none is.
    generate(\Commerz\Catalog\Variants\Data\GenerateVariants $command): \Commerz\Catalog\Variants\Data\GeneratedVariants;
    list(\Commerz\Catalog\Variants\Data\ListVariants $query): \Commerz\Pagination\Page;
    restore(\Commerz\Catalog\Variants\Data\RestoreVariant $command): \Commerz\Catalog\Variants\Data\VariantView;
    setAttributes(\Commerz\Catalog\Variants\Data\SetVariantAttributes $command): \Commerz\Catalog\Variants\Data\VariantView;
    update(\Commerz\Catalog\Variants\Data\UpdateVariant $command): \Commerz\Catalog\Variants\Data\VariantView;
    // Batch upserts variants by `sku` in one atomic transaction with bounded SQL queries, grouped `cmz_attribute_index` reindexing, and compressed Outbox events.
    upsertMany(\Commerz\Catalog\Variants\Data\UpsertVariants $command): \Commerz\Catalog\Variants\Data\UpsertVariantsResult;
}
```

### ArchiveVariant {#type-commerz-catalog-variants-data-archivevariant}

`Commerz\Catalog\Variants\Data\ArchiveVariant`

Archives a variant; its combination stays taken. Archiving an archived variant changes nothing.

```php
final readonly class ArchiveVariant {
    public readonly \Commerz\Catalog\Variants\Data\VariantId $variant;
    __construct(\Commerz\Catalog\Variants\Data\VariantId $variant);
}
```

### CreateVariant {#type-commerz-catalog-variants-data-createvariant}

`Commerz\Catalog\Variants\Data\CreateVariant`

Creates one variant of a product. `axes` names a value of every axis of the product, and nothing else; a product without axes has exactly one variant, created with no axes.

```php
final readonly class CreateVariant {
    public readonly array $attributes;
    public readonly array $axes;
    public readonly ?string $barcode;
    public readonly ?\Commerz\Catalog\Variants\Data\Dimensions $dimensions;
    public readonly ?int $position;
    public readonly \Commerz\Catalog\Products\Data\ProductId $product;
    public readonly string $sku;
    public readonly ?string $taxClass;
    public readonly ?int $weightGrams;
    __construct(\Commerz\Catalog\Products\Data\ProductId $product, string $sku, array $axes = [], ?string $barcode = null, array $attributes = [], ?string $taxClass = null, ?int $weightGrams = null, ?\Commerz\Catalog\Variants\Data\Dimensions $dimensions = null, ?int $position = null);
}
```

`Commerz\Catalog\Variants\Data\Dimensions`

Package size of a variant in millimetres.

```php
final readonly class Dimensions {
    public readonly int $heightMm;
    public readonly int $lengthMm;
    public readonly int $widthMm;
    __construct(int $lengthMm, int $widthMm, int $heightMm);
}
```

### GenerateVariants {#type-commerz-catalog-variants-data-generatevariants}

`Commerz\Catalog\Variants\Data\GenerateVariants`

Creates the variants of the given combinations: the cartesian product of `axes` (in the product's axis order and the given value order) without the `except` combinations. Combinations the product already has are skipped, so a repeated generation is safe. `skuPattern` names each axis as `{optionCode}`, replaced by the value code; every axis with more than one value must appear in it. Generated variants carry no attributes.

```php
final readonly class GenerateVariants {
    public readonly array $axes;
    public readonly bool $dryRun;
    public readonly array $except;
    public readonly \Commerz\Catalog\Products\Data\ProductId $product;
    public readonly string $skuPattern;
    __construct(\Commerz\Catalog\Products\Data\ProductId $product, array $axes, string $skuPattern, array $except = [], bool $dryRun = false);
}
```

### GeneratedVariants {#type-commerz-catalog-variants-data-generatedvariants}

`Commerz\Catalog\Variants\Data\GeneratedVariants`

Outcome of `generate`: every planned combination is either created or skipped (it existed); a dry run creates none.

```php
final readonly class GeneratedVariants {
    public readonly array $created;
    public readonly bool $dryRun;
    public readonly array $planned;
    public readonly array $skipped;
    __construct(array $planned, array $created, array $skipped, bool $dryRun);
}
```

### UpdateVariant {#type-commerz-catalog-variants-data-updatevariant}

`Commerz\Catalog\Variants\Data\UpdateVariant`

```php
    public readonly ?\Commerz\Catalog\Variants\Data\Dimensions $dimensions;
    public readonly ?int $position;
    public readonly ?string $sku;
    public readonly ?string $taxClass;
    public readonly \Commerz\Catalog\Variants\Data\VariantId $variant;
    public readonly ?int $weightGrams;
    __construct(\Commerz\Catalog\Variants\Data\VariantId $variant, ?string $sku = null, ?string $barcode = null, ?string $taxClass = null, ?int $weightGrams = null, ?\Commerz\Catalog\Variants\Data\Dimensions $dimensions = null, ?int $position = null, array $clear = []);
}
```

### UpsertVariants {#type-commerz-catalog-variants-data-upsertvariants}

`Commerz\Catalog\Variants\Data\UpsertVariants`

Batch variant upsert command: validates all SKUs upfront, performs bulk `INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (sku) DO UPDATE`, reindexes `cmz_attribute_index` in grouped statements, and emits compressed Outbox events.

```php
final readonly class UpsertVariants {
    const MAX_ITEMS = 5000;
    public readonly array $items;
    __construct(array $items);
}
```

```php
    __construct(array $variants, array $createdIds, array $updatedIds, int $createdCount, int $updatedCount, int $indexedFactCount, int $outboxEventCount);
}
```
